title: [GMCP 203.028.02] Production path: Secrets, credentials, and cryptographic lifecycle
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-028-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: MCP credentials and private keys live in OS-backed secret storage or an explicit encrypted fallback, are referenced rather than copied into configs, and follow creation, least-scope, rotation, revocation, export prohibition and secure deletion policies. Secret scanning, redaction canaries and crash/core-dump tests prove secrets do not enter arguments, logs, traces, task files, environment inheritance or diagnostics. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
